function.name: calculate_emissions
function.description: Calculates the annual carbon dioxide emissions produced by a vehicle based on the distance traveled, the fuel type and the fuel efficiency of the vehicle.

fuel_type.description: Type of fuel used by the vehicle.

fuel_efficiency.description: The vehicle's fuel efficiency in miles per gallon. This is a float type value.

efficiency_reduction.description: The percentage decrease in fuel efficiency per year (optional). Default is 0
